- [citeget.names](_autosummary/citeget.names.html.md): Author-name parsing for libgen metadata.
- [citeget.rank](_autosummary/citeget.rank.html.md): Rank libgen search results against a requested title and author.
- [citeget.resolve](_autosummary/citeget.resolve.html.md): Composable download and URL-resolution for academic references.
- [citeget.validate](_autosummary/citeget.validate.html.md): Validate that a downloaded file is actually the book or paper it claims to be.
